name: api_iee_approve
_description: POST /api/v1/iee/approve - mueve iee_reports_draft (status='draft') a iee_reports (status='approved'). Tecnico firma. CTE atomica con set_session_context inline para evitar bug RLS B64.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4) AS ok
),
d AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM iee_reports_draft s, ctx
  WHERE s.id = $1::uuid AND s.status = 'draft' LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO iee_reports (
    project_id, tenant_id, estado_conservacion, condiciones_accesibilidad,
    eficiencia_energetica, calificacion_global, recomendaciones, draft_content,
    status, approved_by, approved_at
  )
  SELECT project_id, tenant_id, estado_conservacion, condiciones_accesibilidad,
         eficiencia_energetica, calificacion_global, recomendaciones, draft_content,
         'approved', $2::uuid, now()
  FROM d
  RETURNING id, project_id, calificacion_global, approved_at
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE iee_reports_draft SET status = 'superseded', approved_by = $2::uuid, approved_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'draft'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT ins.id AS final_id, ins.project_id, ins.calificacion_global, ins.approved_at,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upd) AS draft_marked_superseded
FROM ins

VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_iee', 'iee_approved', 'success', $2)
